title: Production Hardening — Infrastructure, Security, DR
acceptance_criteria: WP01: Helm Charts deployed, HPA active, PostgreSQL replication, ClickHouse replication, Redpanda RF=3, Multi-Region
WP02: 6 RBAC roles, AES-256 API key vault, network zones, immutable audit trail, 0 critical snyk/semgrep
WP03: WAL archiving + restore, ClickHouse snapshots, 3 tested runbooks, automated backup verify, RTO<15min, RPO<5min
WP04: 1000 candles/sec ingestion, 100 analysis runs/sec, health<500ms, analysis<5s, memory stable
WP05: Hash-chain trade log, MiFID II reports, GDPR right-to-erasure, data export, retention policies, SOC 2 checklist
critical_path: WP02 → WP04 | WP03 → WP05 | WP01 → WP04
rollback_strategy: Docker Compose fallback, blue/green Kubernetes deployment, versioned reversible commits
